import os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
script=pathlib.Path('scripts/restore-runner-tmp.sh').resolve()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.temp/review-bisu6n') as td:
 base=pathlib.Path(td).resolve()
 outside=base/'outside'; outside.mkdir(); payload=outside/'payload'; payload.write_text('sentinel'); payload.chmod(0o400)
 for name in ['-root','space root','root\n\n','root.']:
  root=base/name; root.mkdir(); child=root/'sealed';child.mkdir(); f=child/'payload'; f.write_text('inside');f.chmod(0o400);child.chmod(0o500)
  (root/'directory-link').symlink_to(outside,target_is_directory=True)
  (root/'dangling').symlink_to(base/'missing')
  p=subprocess.run(['bash',str(script)],env=dict(os.environ,TMPDIR=str(root)),capture_output=True,text=True)
  assert p.returncode==0,(name,p.stderr)
  assert child.stat().st_mode&0o200 and f.stat().st_mode&0o200,name
  assert payload.stat().st_mode&0o200==0,name
  assert payload.read_text()=='sentinel' and f.read_text()=='inside'
  assert (root/'directory-link').is_symlink() and (root/'dangling').is_symlink()
  print(repr(name),'held: sealed child healed; external directory target and links unchanged')
 payload.chmod(0o600)
